title: CapabilityManifest
description: One capability's metadata as exposed under a tools/list entry's `_meta.symbiosis` (docs/protocol.md sections 3.1 and 8). Runtime capabilities use dotted namespaces from the spec (telephony.*, messaging.*, contacts.*, notifications.*, apps.*, ui.*, media.*, device.*, location.*, sensors.*, files.*, connectivity.*, events.*); MCP tool names are the capability names verbatim.

action_class.description: Determines both scope-ceiling visibility (section 2) and the policy pipeline's class default (section 6).

tier.description: 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). protocol.md v0 does not further define tier semantics beyond this numeric ordering.

rate_class.description: Which rate_counters bucket (section 6, pipeline step 8) this capability's calls consume.

emits_events.description: Topics (see event.json #/$defs/topic) this capability may cause to be journaled.

source.description: Present only when this capability is a passthrough of a droid-mcp tool: "droid-mcp:<original_name>" (section 8). Absent for natively implemented capabilities.
